caption: The drawing features a collection of twenty textile swatches, each rectangular or square, arranged in a roughly rectangular grid on an off-white background. The swatches vary in size, with some much larger than others. The majority of the textiles are depicted in shades of brown and beige, with a few containing accents of blue or white. The designs on the swatches include geometric patterns (such as grids, stripes, checks, and borders), botanical motifs (including leaves and flowers), and more abstract or organic forms. Some swatches present bold contrasts between dark and light areas, while others have softer, more muted tonal variations. The largest swatch, located towards the center left, is divided diagonally with different linear and floral designs on each half. The upper left swatch and the bottom left swatch, both featuring blue highlights, repeat a motif of cloudy shapes with brown backgrounds. Several of the smaller swatches on the right feature repetitive, small motifs, including diamonds, dots, and stylized foliage. The overall composition is balanced, with the various patterns and colors distributed evenly across the page.
title: Printed Cotton
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
